rules.conservative_probability: p_adjusted = mid + k (p - mid) (thesis.expression); per-script EV subtracts delta = p - p_adjusted from P(side | script)
rules.ordering: data quality OK > not REJECTED > not FRAGILE > research score; research score = adjusted EV (c) x (0.5 + mass survived) x reliability weight x dependency factor x liquidity factor x exposure factor (x1.10 if FUNDED_RESEARCH)

base_rates.source: official NHL finals (data/history/nhl games + data/history/players goals/goalies), completed regular seasons only

taxonomy.caveat: simulated shot volume comes from the goalie-saves layer with muted score effects; GOALIE_DRIVEN is expected to be under-forecast relative to history. The script calibration report measures it.
taxonomy.partition: mutually exclusive by precedence; probabilities are integer draw counts and sum to 1

thresholds.provenance: a priori; aligned with thesis.scripts cut points; base rates 8-25% on 2022-23..2025-26 official finals; never fit to a slate

tiers.DOES_NOT_SURVIVE: adjusted EV <= 0 at the executable ask
tiers.FRAGILE: adjusted EV > 0 but below the MODERATE thresholds
tiers.MODERATE: adjusted EV >= 0.01 and mass survived >= 0.45 and >= 2 major scripts survived
tiers.ROBUST: adjusted EV >= 0.02 and mass survived >= 0.65 and >= 3 major scripts survived
tiers.UNAVAILABLE: no executable ask, stale or crossed board, or not pregame

scripts.breaks: Any team pulling clear with territorial control, a goalie steal, or a power-play barrage.
scripts.label: Back-and-forth game
scripts.needs: Neither team establishes sustained control, and the score stays within reach.
scripts.rule: everything not matched above (the explicit catch-all; no hidden 'other' bucket)
scripts.summary: A normal-scoring game with roughly even play, usually decided late or by one goal.

scripts.breaks: Either goalie settles in, or one team shuts the game down after taking a lead.
scripts.label: Open, high-event game
scripts.needs: Both offenses generate quality chances and the goaltending does not hold.
scripts.summary: Chances flow both ways and the scoreboard keeps moving: eight or more goals.

scripts.breaks: A clean, low-penalty game decided at even strength.
scripts.label: Special teams decide it
scripts.needs: Penalties pile up and one power play converts at least twice.
scripts.rule: a team scores >= 2 power-play goals and they are at least half of its goals
scripts.summary: Power plays drive the scoring: one side converts repeatedly with the man advantage.

scripts.breaks: WSH's goalie stealing it, or WSH keeping it to a one-goal game.
scripts.label: PIT controls and pulls away
scripts.needs: PIT out-chances WSH and converts enough to pull clear.
scripts.rule: away wins by 2+ with >= 50% of the shots on goal
scripts.summary: PIT holds the territorial edge on the road and wins by two or more.

scripts.breaks: An early multi-goal lead, or either team's finishing running hot.
scripts.label: Tight, low-event game
scripts.needs: Both teams defend well and neither power play converts much.
scripts.rule: <= 4 non-shootout goals and a one-goal final or overtime
scripts.summary: Few chances, strong goaltending, and a one-goal or overtime finish with four goals or fewer.

scripts.breaks: PIT's goalie stealing it, or PIT keeping it to a one-goal game.
scripts.label: WSH controls and pulls away
scripts.needs: WSH out-chances PIT and converts enough to pull clear (an empty-net goal often seals it).
scripts.rule: home wins by 2+ with >= 50% of the shots on goal
scripts.summary: WSH holds the territorial edge and wins by two or more.

scripts.breaks: The team with the territorial edge simply converts its shot volume.
scripts.label: Goaltending steals it
scripts.needs: The out-shot team's goalie stops nearly everything and it converts its few chances.
scripts.rule: the winner had <= 42% of the shots on goal
scripts.summary: One team is clearly out-shot and wins anyway behind its goaltender or opportunistic finishing.
